notes: Unified protocol = research/checklist_focus_20260923 (the only SI study run to completion under one protocol). Editor and critic are the same model; the editor is text-only (no images); max 8 revisions after R0; the judge is GPT-5.6-terra (medium effort, 1 call per benchmark checklist item, all-pass scoring).

Critic input: the GPT-5.6-sol / GPT-6-luna / GPT-5.6-terra critics see the six ORIGINAL/MODIFIED view pairs (no code); the gpt-oss-120b critic sees code only (no images) in every condition of this study.

Round semantics: round k is the k-th code version (R0 = initial one-shot edit). The critic entry of round k is the decision on version k; its feedback_to_editor is what the editor receives to produce version k+1. stop_satisfied = the critic accepted the version; stop_budget = 8 revisions used.

Terra verdicts are the benchmark judge (GPT-5.6-terra, not human labels). The critic never sees the benchmark checklist except in golden_* conditions; in self_q it builds its own checklist (critic_self_built_checklist).
Curves are carry-forward: after a trajectory stops, its final version is counted in later rounds.

Images: each round strip shows the MODIFIED render in six views (order in "views"); source_strip shows the ORIGINAL. Renders are 512px, downsized to 168px tiles (strips) and 384px (key views). Each render pair is framed on the joint bounding box of original+modified, so object scale differs between rounds; compare shapes, not sizes.
R0 renders come from the historical v157 render set (GPT-5.6-sol/terra, gpt-oss-120b) or new baselines (GPT-6-luna); rounds >= 1 were read (read-only) from the study's zipped render packs.
Feedback texts are verbatim, whitespace-collapsed, trimmed to <=300 chars with "…"; Terra evidence trimmed to <=220 chars.

feedback_types.free: Critic sees the six ORIGINAL/MODIFIED view pairs and writes free-form feedback; "satisfied" stops the loop.
feedback_types.free2: Control: two independent free-form critics; stop only if both are satisfied.
feedback_types.static: Critic first builds its own checklist from the task, then marks every item satisfied/violated in one call per round.
feedback_types.golden_static: Same as static but with the benchmark (evaluation) checklist given to the critic.
feedback_types.self_q: Main (frozen) mechanism: the critic's own checklist is verified one requirement per call; each requirement is split into explicit qualifiers (part, count, ratio, shape, orientation, position, contact, what must stay unchanged); anything that cannot be confirmed fails; the loop stops only if every requirement passes; otherwise a separate call writes repair advice for the failed requirements.
feedback_types.self_q_guard: Post-freeze variant of self_q explored after the held-out freeze (round 4); not adopted.
feedback_types.old_protocol_free: Older protocol (2026-09-18): one free-form critic call per round.
feedback_types.old_protocol_static: Older protocol: checklist generated from task and original images before t0, checked whole in one call per round.
feedback_types.old_protocol_dynamic: Older protocol: shares the static initial checklist but keeps only active violated/uncertain issues as the editor's to-do list.
feedback_types.old_protocol_self_check: Older protocol: no separate critic; the editor declares completion itself, checked after rendering.
